title: Combined attach not accepted by the network

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when attach request is not accepted. Contains EMM cause value and may include T3346 value IE.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element in ATTACH REJECT message indicating reason for rejection. Various values trigger different UE behaviors.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Back-off timer assigned by network for congestion control. UE starts this timer when receiving integrity-protected ATTACH REJECT.

entities.name: Timer T3410
entities.description: Timer running during attach procedure. UE stops this timer upon receiving ATTACH REJECT message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by UE after attach rejection. Has substates like LIMITED-SERVICE, PLMN-SEARCH, and NO-IMSI.

entities.name: MM IDLE
entities.description: MM state entered by UE after receiving ATTACH REJECT message with integrity protection or reject cause other than #25.

entities.name: Integrity protection required
entities.description: Condition where ATTACH REJECT message must be integrity protected for UE to process certain cause values and start timers.

entities.name: UE cleanup actions
entities.description: UE actions after attach rejection including deleting GUTI, TAI list, eKSI, resetting counters, and updating EPS status.

entities.name: Forbidden lists
entities.description: UE stores PLMNs or TAIs in forbidden lists based on EMM cause value and integrity protection status.

entities.name: PLMN selection
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE after attach rejection with certain EMM cause values according to TS 23.122.

relations.description: ATTACH REJECT message contains EMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
UE stops timer T3410 upon receiving ATTACH REJECT message with integrity protection or cause other than #25.
UE enters MM IDLE state after receiving ATTACH REJECT with integrity protection or cause other than #25.
UE starts T3346 with provided value only if ATTACH REJECT is integrity protected.
Specific EMM cause values trigger UE cleanup actions like deleting GUTI, TAI list, and updating EPS status.
UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state with specific substate based on EMM cause value.
UE stores PLMNs or TAIs in forbidden lists based on EMM cause value and integrity protection.
Certain EMM cause values trigger UE to perform PLMN selection procedure.
ATTACH REJECT message with cause #25 must be integrity protected for UE to process it.
UE starts timer T3346 when T3346 value IE is present in ATTACH REJECT message.
